policies.title: British citizen passports: specified visa-free visitor stays
policies.summary: Current FCDO guidance establishes visa-free ordinary British-citizen passport visitor stays for the listed destinations.
conditions: MK: up to 3 months; GD: up to 3 months; BS: normally up to 30 days; NU: up to 30 days.
Ordinary British-citizen passports only. Passport, return/onward ticket, accommodation, border, health, extension and final-admission rules remain applicable.

policies.title: British citizen passports: specified visitor visas available on arrival
policies.summary: Current official guidance establishes arrival-issued ordinary visitor visa routes for the listed destinations.
conditions: BD: Dhaka airport issue is discretionary, requires a return ticket and proof of funds, and is single-entry for 15 to 30 days.
CI: obtain approval online before travel; SNEDAI prints and issues the visa after biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport.

SL: visitor/business visa may be issued on arrival for USD 80 cash; JO: single-entry visit visa is available at an airport or Sheikh Hussein/North Border crossing, but not at King Hussein/Allenby Bridge.

policies.title: British citizen passports: expressly electronic pre-travel visas or entry permits
policies.summary: Current official guidance establishes electronic pre-travel issuance for the listed ordinary British-citizen visitor scopes.
conditions: BF: UK residents may apply online and Visa Burkina confirms electronic issuance; ML: the fully online process issues the entry permit electronically once approved.
SS: FCDO directs British visitors online and the Interior portal supplies the approved eVisa PDF; SY: FCDO links the eVisa service and states a 5-to-7-day decision period.
Passport, health, sponsor, invitation, entry-point, purpose and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: British citizen passports: specified advance visitor visas
policies.summary: Current FCDO guidance establishes an ordinary British-citizen visitor visa application through the stated embassy or advance process for the listed destinations.
conditions: KP: tourist travel is normally organised and the visa application is sent directly to the North Korean Embassy; current general-entry restrictions remain material.
TD, CG, GW, LR and NE: FCDO directs the British-citizen visitor to the named embassy/consular application route before travel.

IR: apply well in advance; a British-passport applicant must use an organised tour or an Iranian sponsor. Kish Island is a distinct travel-agency/approval-before-arrival exception, not a general waiver.

conflicts.explanation: Online approval is required before travel, but SNEDAI's current officially recognised procedure prints and issues the visa only after biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport.

Current FCDO guidance says a British citizen must have a Guinea-Bissau visa and directs applications to its Embassy in Paris or another neighbouring-country embassy; it does not establish an arrival-issued route.
FCDO says Mali's visa application and payment are fully online and an approved entry permit is issued electronically.
Current FCDO guidance says a full British-citizen passport holder may visit Niue without a visa for up to 30 days.

unresolved.reason: Current FCDO guidance says a visa is required but the Afghan Embassy in London is closed and does not establish an ordinary British-citizen visitor issuance channel or timing. No electronic, advance-consular or arrival-issued route is inferred.

FCDO's current Israel-and-Palestine guidance is route- and territory-specific. It does not establish a single ordinary British-citizen ETA, visa, eVisa, waiver or arrival-visa status for the exact PS scope; West Bank access depends on Israeli entry procedures and Gaza remains separately restricted. No complement is inferred.
